Magearna

Steel Fairy

Alola · Generation 7 · Mythical Pokémon

Magearna is a Steel/Fairy-type Artificial Pokémon first found in Alola (Generation 7), and is classed as a Mythical Pokémon. It stands 1 m tall and weighs 80.5 kg. It does not evolve. Its highest base stat is Sp. Atk (130), with a base stat total of 600.
